title: nwc → ss OIDC userinfo claim set
description: The CLOSED allow-list of claims nwc (provider, native simple_oauth /oauth/userinfo) emits to the Moodle consumer (auth_nwc). Derived from NwcOidcClaimsServiceProvider::REQUIRED_CLAIMS. additionalProperties:false is deliberate — it is the data-minimisation gate (P74 §Phase-0 / intersite-contract research §2). Adding a claim here is a boundary change: it must go through the contract_version bump + the ss side's review. `sub` is the load-bearing UID-lock join key (= Drupal user.uuid(), NOT the serial uid — ADR-0031 D9 / ops#83).

sub.description: Subject identifier = Drupal user.uuid() — the STABLE account UUID, NOT the serial uid. THE UID-lock join key → mdl_user.idnumber. ADR-0031 D9 / ops#83 moved this off the uid (shipped 03672e2, live 2026-07-11): a DB restore/rebuild renumbers uids and would sever every ss UID-lock, whereas the UUID survives. Emitted by nwc_oidc_claims, which overrides simple_oauth's uid default. Must be stable and never reused.

given_name.description: Standard OIDC claim → Moodle firstname (issuer field mapping). simple_oauth's normalizer never emits this (Drupal core has no first/last concept), so nwc_oidc_claims synthesises it from the Open Social profile. Without it the SSO'd member is bounced to Moodle's 'complete your profile' form with a blank name. ops#89.

family_name.description: Standard OIDC claim → Moodle lastname. See given_name.

email_verified.description: MUST be the real verification state (never hardcoded true — see F26 M1). A hardcoded true enables takeover-by-email on the Moodle side.

updated_at.description: Seconds since epoch (OIDC core) — integer, not a date string.

guilds.description: The ONE custom claim. Guild membership + per-guild role machine-names. Sole writer = nwc_oidc_claims (after the F26 flat-vs-nested collision fix). Role machine-names are a shared vocabulary across the boundary — renaming one silently changes what Moodle receives (see research §1 silent-break risks).

id.description: Serial group id. DEBUG/back-compat ONLY — renumber-fragile. Bind on `uuid`.

uuid.description: STABLE group UUID — the key consumers MUST bind on. `id` is the serial group id and renumbers on any DB restore/rebuild, which would orphan every cohort binding: the same failure ADR-0031 D9 fixed for `sub`. Optional only until the ss consumer adopts it (adding a required field is breaking per contracts/compat.py); it is always emitted. FOLLOW-UP: promote to required once auth_nwc reads it.

type.description: Group bundle: 'guild' (Sojourners, Media Guild, Trialing Guild) or 'flexible_group' (the IGs). Both are 'guilds you are drawn to' per nwc_registration.guild_mapping, whose header reads 'the guild/IG (group label)'.
